Relation: head of government
Description: head of the executive power of this town, city, municipality, state, country, or other governmental body
Aliases:
  - mayor
  - prime minister
  - premier
  - first minister
  - chancellor
Inverse Name: none recorded

Ancestors:
  - director / manager (person who manages any kind of group or organisation)
  - chairperson (presiding member of an organization, group or body)
  - significant person (person linked to the item in any possible way)

Source types:
  - political territorial entity (region accepted to be in the jurisdiction of a particular government entity)
  - government (system or group of people governing an organized community)
  - cabinet (group of high ranking officials representing the executive branch)
  - term of office (time limit for a politician holding a given position)
  - government agency (part of a government responsible for specific public services)

Target types:
  - human (any single member of Homo sapiens)
  - character (fictional human or non-human character in a narrative work)

Constraints:
  - symmetric? no
  - transitive? no
  - single value? no
  - distinct values? no
  - direction: source -> target

Examples:
  - political territorial entity: Gabon -> Raymond Ndong Sima
  - political territorial entity: Cluj-Napoca -> Emil Boc
  - political territorial entity: Fredrikstad Municipality -> Jon-Ivar Nygård
  - political territorial entity: Tirapu -> Iñaki Lafuente
  - government: Boston -> Michelle Wu
  - government: Chuisnes -> Jacky Jaulneau
  - government: Équeurdreville-Hainneville -> Bernard Cauvin
  - cabinet: Duterte Cabinet -> Rodrigo Duterte

Slug: head-of-government

Relation: exact-match mapping
Description: maps a source identifier to the one canonical record it denotes
Inverse Name: none recorded

Source types:
  - identifier (token used to identify one record)

Target types:
  - canonical record (authoritative representation of an item)

Constraints:
  - symmetric? no
  - direction: source -> target

Examples:
  - stock code: SKU 1001 -> catalog item 1001
  - country code: ISO alpha-2 US -> United States
  - record key: A-17 -> canonical record A-17

Slug: exact-match-mapping

Relation: same canonical identifier
Description: two references normalize to the same persistent identity
Inverse Name: none recorded

Source types:
  - alias (alternate reference to an entity)

Target types:
  - canonical entity (single authoritative entity)

Constraints:
  - symmetric? yes
  - direction: symmetric

Examples:
  - entity alias: Alias Q42 -> entity Q42
  - normalized key: external key -> stored key
  - database reference: first reference -> same row

Slug: same-canonical-identifier

Relation: component of
Description: subject is a distinct structural component contained by the target
Inverse Name: none recorded

Source types:
  - component (separable constituent of a larger assembly)

Target types:
  - assembly (whole composed of multiple parts)

Constraints:
  - symmetric? no
  - direction: source -> target

Examples:
  - hardware: wheel -> bicycle
  - document: chapter -> book
  - processor: core -> CPU

Slug: component-of

Relation: member of collection
Description: subject belongs to a containing collection without being identical to it
Inverse Name: none recorded

Source types:
  - member (individual item in a collection)

Target types:
  - collection (container grouping related members)

Constraints:
  - symmetric? no
  - direction: source -> target

Examples:
  - media: track -> album
  - filesystem: file -> directory
  - geography: district -> city

Slug: member-of-collection

Relation: authored by
Description: identifies the creator responsible for a written or software work
Inverse Name: none recorded

Source types:
  - authored work (artifact produced through authorship)

Target types:
  - creator (person or group responsible for the work)

Constraints:
  - symmetric? no
  - direction: source -> target

Examples:
  - novel: Frankenstein -> Mary Shelley
  - research: paper -> listed researchers
  - software: module -> commit signer

Slug: authored-by

Relation: attributed to
Description: links an artifact or statement to the agent credited with it
Inverse Name: none recorded

Source types:
  - attributed artifact (work, statement, or design carrying a credit)

Target types:
  - credited agent (person or organization receiving attribution)

Constraints:
  - symmetric? no
  - direction: source -> target

Examples:
  - photograph: image -> studio
  - quotation: statement -> speaker
  - building: design -> named architect

Slug: attributed-to

Relation: associated operationally with
Description: underspecified operational association whose semantics vary by source
Inverse Name: none recorded

Source types:
  - operational entity (actor, device, or document in a process)

Target types:
  - operational context (organization, platform, or program)

Constraints:
  - symmetric? no
  - direction: source -> target

Examples:
  - procurement: contractor -> agency
  - telemetry: sensor -> platform
  - reporting: report -> program

Slug: associated-operationally-with

Relation: supports
Description: overloaded relation spanning service, physical, and evidentiary support
Inverse Name: none recorded

Source types:
  - supporting entity (entity described as providing support)

Target types:
  - supported entity (entity receiving an unspecified kind of support)

Constraints:
  - symmetric? no
  - direction: source -> target

Examples:
  - operations: team -> service
  - structure: bracket -> shelf
  - reasoning: evidence -> conclusion

Slug: supports

Relation: represents
Description: links a representation or delegate to a distinct referent
Inverse Name: none recorded

Source types:
  - representation (symbol, delegate, or record standing for something)

Target types:
  - referent (entity being represented)

Constraints:
  - symmetric? no
  - direction: source -> target

Examples:
  - interface: icon -> application
  - government: delegate -> district
  - logistics: record -> physical shipment

Slug: represents

Relation: linked to
Description: generic link without a stable structural or attribution meaning
Inverse Name: none recorded

Source types:
  - linked entity (entity carrying a reference or connection)

Target types:
  - linked target (destination of the generic connection)

Constraints:
  - symmetric? no
  - direction: source -> target

Examples:
  - citation: citation -> source
  - identity: account -> device
  - transport: station -> main line

Slug: linked-to

Relation: identical canonical target
Description: both references resolve to one canonical identity
Inverse Name: none recorded

Source types:
  - alias (alternate identifier for an entity)

Target types:
  - canonical entity (authoritative identity record)

Constraints:
  - symmetric? yes
  - direction: symmetric

Examples:
  - entity alias: first alias -> same canonical entity
  - normalized key: external key -> stored identifier
  - redirect: first key -> one target

Slug: identical-canonical-target

Relation: structural part of
Description: subject is a distinct structural part contained by the target
Inverse Name: none recorded

Source types:
  - component (separable part of a larger structure)

Target types:
  - whole (structure containing the component)

Constraints:
  - symmetric? no
  - direction: source -> target

Examples:
  - hardware: keyboard -> laptop
  - narrative: scene -> film
  - infrastructure: rack -> data center

Slug: structural-part-of

Relation: created by
Description: attributes a distinct work to the agent responsible for creating it
Inverse Name: none recorded

Source types:
  - created work (artifact produced by a creator)

Target types:
  - creator (person or group responsible for the work)

Constraints:
  - symmetric? no
  - direction: source -> target

Examples:
  - literature: novel -> author
  - visual art: mural -> artist
  - software: patch -> contributor

Slug: created-by

Relation: connected with
Description: generic connection lacking one stable semantic interpretation
Inverse Name: none recorded

Source types:
  - connected entity (entity participating in an unspecified connection)

Target types:
  - connection target (entity at the other end of the connection)

Constraints:
  - symmetric? unknown
  - direction: not specified

Examples:
  - policy: initiative -> department
  - systems: device -> service
  - events: person -> event

Slug: connected-with
